_comment: Copy this to <your-repo>/.vscode/mcp.json to register the server with Copilot Chat.

_instructions.graph_only_mode: Remove EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT and EMBEDDING_MODEL if using graph-only mode
_instructions.neo4j_optional: NEO4J_* variables are used automatically by get_blast_radius_from_changes to visualize results. Omit them (or leave Neo4j offline) and that tool still returns the full text/JSON analysis, just without the graph.
_instructions.azure_openai: For Azure OpenAI, set EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT to your deployment URL and EMBEDDING_API_KEY
